description: This file contains unit tests for the BatchWorkerCondition class, verifying its behavior based on environment properties related to batch worker enabling status.

classes.name: BatchWorkerConditionTest
classes.description: A unit test class for BatchWorkerCondition, testing its logic under different environment configurations.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test, setting up the mock environment and mocking behavior for conditionContext.

methods.name: testMatchesShouldReturnFalseWhenWorkerDisabled
methods.description: Tests that the condition's matches method returns false when the 'fineract.mode.batch-worker-enabled' property is set to false.

methods.name: testMatchesShouldReturnTrueWhenWorkerEnabled
methods.description: Tests that the condition's matches method returns true when the 'fineract.mode.batch-worker-enabled' property is set to true.
